CORAM: - HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AMBUJ NATH -----
For the Petitioner : Mr. Anup Kr. Agarwal, Advocate For the State : Mr. P. D. Agrawal, Spl.P.P.
---
02/06.12.2025 Heard the parties.

The petitioner has been made accused in connection with Latehar P.S. Case No. 144 of 2025, for the offences registered under Sections 376(2)(n) of the I.P.C., pending in the court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Latehar.
On the pretext of marriage, the petitioner is alleged to have established consensual physical relationship with the prosecutrix, who is the major lady.
Rs.5 lakhs were demanded as dowry by the family members of the petitioner, due to which their marriage could not be solemnized.
It was submitted that parties were in relationship since last three years.
In view of the aforesaid facts, I am inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.

Accordingly, the petitioner, above named, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bonds of Rs. 20,000/-
(Rupees twenty thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Latehar, in connection with Latehar P.S. Case No. 144 of 2025.

(Ambuj Nath, J.) December 6, 2025 Jay/-
